llm_tip_model.message:
Pick the LLM model used for screening (Gemini / OpenRouter).
■ Gemini (Google AI Studio key required)
• Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite: recommended. Low-cost & fast (depression Recall 93.6%, ~$0.30/1K items).
• Gemini 3 Flash Preview: higher accuracy (depression Recall 96.1%, ~$1.70/1K items).

■ OpenRouter (OpenRouter key required)
• Qwen3 235B Instruct (2507): Recall 93.9% / Specificity 92.2% / ~$0.135/1K items.
• DeepSeek V4 Flash: Recall 91.1% / Specificity 90.5% / ~$0.756/1K items.

The corresponding API key card is highlighted based on the selected provider. See the latest benchmark via the link below.

llm_tip_tier.message:
Select your Gemini API tier. Parallel requests and save batch size are derived automatically from this tier.

■ How to check your tier
1. Open https://aistudio.google.com/usage
2. See the current tier under "Billing"

■ Tier overview
• Tier 1: instant after enabling billing (300 RPM)
• Tier 2: cumulative $100 + 3 days after first payment (2,000 RPM)
• Tier 3: cumulative $1,000 + 30 days (4,000+ RPM)

A wrong selection causes frequent rate-limit errors. If unsure, choose Tier 1.

llm_tip_maxCount.message:
Maximum number of pending references to process in this run.
For example, if 10,000 references are pending and you choose 100, only the first 100 will be processed and the remaining 9,900 will be carried over to subsequent runs.
Choose "All" to process every pending reference.

llm_tip_threshold.message:
Choose how broadly AI should collect include candidates.
0.3: broad
0.5: standard. Use this if unsure
0.7: strict
You can adjust while checking the distribution graph below.

ml_tip_stopping.message:
Choose when screening should be considered finished.
Recommended:
• 50 consecutive Excludes (simple rule)
• Target recall 95% / confidence 95% (statistical rule)
Pick based on the project size.
